gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Seismic site classification codes (IBC/ASCE 7 Site Class A-F, based on the average properties of the upper profile at the site) applied to the treated ground mass after rigid inclusion ground improvement (V2 Post-installation row 31). Used for the value of diggs:RigidInclusionSystemType/seismicSiteClass. States the interpreted classification only; the composite shear-wave velocity a determination is based on is a separate, already-expressible measurement (diggs:LabVelocityTest, diggs:GeophysicalFieldSurvey). PROVISIONAL: the six class descriptions are stated from the standard's general definition and have not been checked line-by-line against a specific ASCE 7 edition's table - flagged for SME confirmation like the project's other provisional dictionary entries.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Seismic Site Class Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Hard rock with high shear-wave velocity, at the stiff end of the site class range.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Site Class A - Hard Rock

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Rock of moderate to high shear-wave velocity, softer than Site Class A.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Site Class B - Rock

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Very dense soil or soft rock, typically high blow count or high undrained shear strength.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Site Class C - Very Dense Soil and Soft Rock

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Stiff soil, the default classification where site-specific data is insufficient to assign another class.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Site Class D - Stiff Soil

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Soft clay soil, or any profile with a sufficient thickness of soft clay meeting the standard's plasticity, moisture and strength thresholds.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Site Class E - Soft Clay Soil

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Soils requiring a site-specific geotechnical investigation and dynamic site response analysis - liquefaction-vulnerable soils, peats, highly organic clays, very high plasticity clays, or very thick soft-to-medium-stiff clays.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Site Class F - Site-Specific
